annotation_type: Technical source review by Codex; not independent human ground truth
scope: Same operational callsite scope as H1: explicitly identifiable allocation/free/copy/formatted-stdio/block/file IO and named caller-supported wrappers/macros. Raw array/asm and unresolved compound helpers are outside scored scope, not safe/no-sink. Conditional compilation branches are represented as a union, except explicit #if 0 sites are excluded.
review_exposure: Reviewer knows E1/E1.1 rules and prior H1 results. Fresh50 predictions were not read before writing these specifications. No target labels or original filenames used for annotations.
